parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and carries is_sample_app=false in the flags but is structurally a sample-app file by directory convention (Examples/WallpaperSampleApp). Per the decision rules, any record residing under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. Lifting the production-side type-alias from DebugPanel into shared code to eliminate this duplication would couple production infrastructure to a demonstration/debug HUD that is intentionally self-contained. No action is warranted.
